subject: maths
question: Two pumps, M and N, can fill a tank in 36 hours and 45 hours, respectively. Another pump P can empty the tank in 30 hours. First M and N are opened, and after 8 hours, P is also opened. The tank will be filled up in total T hours. The value of T is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM(36, 45, 30) = 180 units.

Efficiencies: M = 5, N = 4, P = −6 (emptying).

In 8 hours, M + N fill: (5 + 4) × 8 = 72 units.

Remaining work = 180 − 72 = 108 units.

Time with all pumps = 108 ÷ (5 + 4 − 6) = 108 ÷ 3 = 36 hours.

Total time T = 8 + 36 = 44 hours.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by M = 36 hours

Time taken by N = 45 hours

Time taken by P = 30 hours (emptying)

Initial duration for M and N = 8 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time
